About Me:

Marbelona is essentially a stylized mash-up of my full name. You could probably find my full name somewhere else, but I don’t feel like spelling it out, so I turned it into this “brand,” if you can call it that.

My interests lie in using technology as a tool to solve real-world problems. For me, it’s nothing more and nothing less than that—a means to create solutions or simply to pass the time when I want to learn or explore something new.

I’m also extremely economical in both life and work. If something no longer serves a purpose or I can’t reasonably afford it, I don’t keep it around—whether personally or in business. I dislike spending resources without some form of return, and that return isn’t limited to money alone.
